title: ‘Suffered an injustice': Egypt coach blasts referee in dramatic World Cup exit to Argentina
summary: Egypt ⁠coach ⁠Hossam Hassan on Tuesday said his team had "suffered an injustice" in ​the wake of his team's loss to Argentina in a round of 16 match in Atlanta. Hassan took issue with the French referee on several counts, including a decision that disallowed a goal that had initially put Egypt up ​2-0.
